items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Wingy went up to Harlem the night before, sat down with some arranger, and sang the themes to him. Then we got to the date.

ctx.x: Wingy went up to Harlem the night before, sat down with some arranger, and sang the themes to him. Then we got to the date. He couldn’t read, so he didn’t remember what he’d written. It was a mess of a date.
It’s quite amusing, though. How did Jelly Roll Morton happen to be on it?
